hypothesis: Persistent risk states can become an economically useful automatic exit.
cohort_definition: Phase 2.7 trajectory observations with consecutive AT_RISK/FAILED states
sample_size: Rule-level trajectory cohort; see source report
tested_rule: Rule A AT_RISK>=3; Rule B FAILED>=2; Rule C FAILED>=3
main_result: Losers sometimes lost less, but winners lost more upside; no rule improved all left-tail thresholds.
winner_effect: Winner opportunity cost exceeded loser savings.
mean_return_effect: Rule B mean delta -0.40pp with fully negative CI; Rule C near flat.
robustness_result: Date bootstrap and time split did not establish positive economic value.

hypothesis: A noisy admission source can be removed while retaining nearly all winners.
cohort_definition: Daily source combinations in the reconstructed candidate cohort
tested_rule: Programmatic removal simulation over A/B/C source groups
main_result: No source group passed the removal criteria; apparently risky groups also contained many winners.
winner_effect: Removal would sacrifice a disproportionate number of winners.
robustness_result: Daily/time split did not rescue a removal rule.

hypothesis: Source combination A+C may be a more efficient candidate context.
cohort_definition: A/B/C source combinations in the same reconstructed cohort
tested_rule: Descriptive comparison of source combination A+C
main_result: A+C had the best candidates-per-winner and big-losers-per-winner, but the analysis was descriptive and non-causal.
mean_return_effect: Not established as an independent mean-return rule.
robustness_result: Insufficient for an automatic removal or ranking rule.
original_conclusion: Positive descriptive finding outside the STOP conclusion

hypothesis: Day1 failure archetypes can veto weak-market candidates safely.
cohort_definition: 159 historical RISK_OFF candidates across 6 dates
tested_rule: Failure archetypes F1-F5 and veto Rules A/B/C
main_result: No archetype or veto was stable; some negative-looking archetypes contained many winners.
robustness_result: Six-date historical check rejected the single-day impression.

hypothesis: Missed strong stocks are mainly lost before the publishing layer.
cohort_definition: 2026-07-23 WATCH plus TOP70-eligible miss audit
tested_rule: Stage-level miss attribution
main_result: Most misses occurred in candidate discovery, but no safe compression rule was produced.
robustness_result: Useful pipeline diagnosis, not an automatic candidate compression predicate.

hypothesis: Existing momentum ordering contains repeatable winner enrichment.
cohort_definition: 8,321 matured raw-union daily events across 20 replay dates
tested_rule: Existing momentum_score order; Top120 vs 121-200 and adjacent rank buckets
main_result: Winner rate declined monotonically from 31.2% in rank 1-40 to 8.2% in rank 501+; Top120 beat 121-200 by 12.0pp.
winner_effect: Strong positive winner enrichment in earlier ranks.
big_loser_effect: Big-loser rate was also higher in earlier ranks, so rank is not a safe hard filter by itself.
mean_return_effect: Mean and median return declined with rank.
robustness_result: Date-block bootstrap confirmed the Top120 winner-rate difference; adjacent buckets showed the same direction.

hypothesis: Replacing Top120 rows with near-miss candidates can improve winner recall without adding losers.
cohort_definition: 20 replay dates with raw union and Top120
tested_rule: Replacement simulations A/B/C at fixed size 120
main_result: All three simulations reduced winner count.
robustness_result: Direction agreed with the monotonic rank gradient.

hypothesis: Fundamental channel D can contribute candidate evidence.
cohort_definition: 20-day reconstructed raw union
tested_rule: Existing D-channel rule
main_result: Upstream revenue coverage was incomplete; the rule could not be evaluated.
robustness_result: Data gap prevented validation.

hypothesis: Extreme rank acceleration can remove weak-market losers.
cohort_definition: Frozen A=246 and stress B=87; stress B has one winner
sample_size: A=246; B=87; B winner=1; B dates=6
tested_rule: Exclude rs_rank_improvement_5d >= 600
main_result: Reached the loser-control goal but not winner dominance; short stress window and one winner.
winner_effect: Winner safety could not be established in the stress cohort.
robustness_result: Provisional six-date stress result only.

hypothesis: Market-aware publishing contraction can control weak-market losers.
cohort_definition: Frozen A=246, B=87, C=140 reconstructed episodes
tested_rule: Frozen market, pocket, and stock-survival policy family
main_result: Policy family reduced stress losers, but winner evidence was insufficient and later attribution removed pocket increment.
robustness_result: Reconstructed, not production exact; superseded by Phase 3G attribution.

hypothesis: Stock survival evidence is the primary source of stress loser control.
cohort_definition: Frozen A=246 and B=87
tested_rule: Frozen survival predicate
main_result: B loser rate fell from 44.8% to 25.0%, but safe rate was 75.0% and A winner recall only 27.3%.
mean_return_effect: Not validated for bull-market mean return.
robustness_result: Wilson interval wide; B had one winner and six dates.

hypothesis: Market contraction adds protection above stock survival.
cohort_definition: Frozen A=246 and B=87
tested_rule: Frozen market gate followed by survival gate
main_result: B loser rate improved another 6.8pp to 18.2%, while A changed only from 15.2% to 16.2%.
winner_effect: Stress cohort had only one winner; bull winner retention not established.
big_loser_effect: Market increment confirmed for stress loser control.
robustness_result: Short stress window; later Phase 3I remained sample-pending.

hypothesis: Momentum pocket activity/durability adds value beyond survival.
cohort_definition: Frozen A=246 and B=87
tested_rule: Pocket-only, pocket+survival, and durability quadrants
main_result: Pocket+survival did not beat survival; directions were inconsistent across A/B.
robustness_result: Later attribution directly rejected the earlier pocket interpretation.

hypothesis: A point-in-time composite can warn at least two sessions before the 7/8 deterioration.
cohort_definition: Pre-July false-alarm audit plus Dataset B
tested_rule: Two-session persistent PROTECTIVE composite
main_result: Persistent signal was only one session earlier; false alarms remained and B loser rate was 40%.
robustness_result: Point-in-time replay explicitly failed the timing requirement.

hypothesis: Point-in-time lifecycle warnings/removals can become automatic actions.
cohort_definition: 2,038 point-in-time valid action rows
tested_rule: WARNING and two-family persistent REMOVE
main_result: Warnings caught 67.1% of losers but prematurely warned 67.0% of winners; removals were also premature for 21.4% of winners.
robustness_result: Corrected the older outcome leakage; all rows were point-in-time valid.

hypothesis: Fixed Day0 positive-structure bundles enrich normal-regime winners safely.
cohort_definition: 168 completed NORMAL episodes
tested_rule: D0-A, D0-B, D0-C fixed bundles
main_result: All Day0 bundles had loser rate above 20%; the nominally best dominance rule was not qualified.
winner_effect: Winner recall/dominance trade-off failed the formal gate.
robustness_result: Identification/locked split did not establish a qualifying Day0 filter.

hypothesis: Follow-through confirmation enriches normal-regime winners after entry.
cohort_definition: 168 completed NORMAL episodes plus locked evaluation slice
sample_size: Best historical policy n=25; locked winner=1
outcome_horizon: Day10 after confirmation and remaining episode horizon
tested_rule: Fixed Day1 and Day3 confirmation bundles
main_result: Historical Day3-A reached 25% winner dominance, but locked evaluation missed its sole winner; confirmation also incurred delay.
winner_effect: Provisional enrichment only; independent winner retention unconfirmed.
big_loser_effect: Not a validated Day0 loser-removal rule.
robustness_result: Small samples and locked slice failed to confirm generalization.

hypothesis: A fixed momentum Top-K is a validated normal-regime compression threshold.
cohort_definition: NORMAL comparison slices
tested_rule: Top-K momentum baselines matched to policy coverage
main_result: Top-K was only a comparator; no fixed K passed a predeclared compression gate.
robustness_result: No independent fixed-K validation.

hypothesis: Frozen NORMAL Day1-C generalizes prospectively.
cohort_definition: Frozen Dataset C plus prospective rows
tested_rule: Frozen D0-A then Day1-C branch
main_result: No independent NORMAL sample was available.
robustness_result: Predicate reproduced with zero mismatches, but outcome validation is pending.

hypothesis: Frozen market+survival generalizes on new weak-market data.
cohort_definition: Dataset C existing pending plus prospective rows
sample_size: selected=29; matured selected=5 from one date; prospective=0
tested_rule: Frozen market+survival branch
main_result: Early read was favorable but came from one matured date and no prospective rows.
big_loser_effect: Zero matured selected losers, early-read only.
robustness_result: Predicate reproduced with zero mismatches; minimum sample not reached and input snapshot blocker remained.
